findings.finding: Prepare trusts the editable completion file and current matrix hash without reauthenticating OLD_MATRIX/matrix-before, old13 equality, assembly originalActuals or real derivation/import receipts. Loaded later trusts only the newly pinned completion hash. An edit between assemble and prepare can therefore make changed old13 history part of the accepted final plan.
findings.requestedFix: At prepare and loaded, use one fixed handoff check: authenticate matrix-before against OLD_MATRIX_SHA, require old13 parsed equality with current/after matrix, bind assembly inputs/actuals and exact completed derive/verify/candidate/default receipts. Preserve the allowed post-assembly commit boundary without rewriting native sources.

findings.rule: AGENTS.md principles4,5,9: bounded trusted execution and diagnosable failures.
findings.finding: Assemble executes REAL_GO and mutates the default matrix before any GO_SHA check; that check appears only in prepare. Helper/observer/Go hashing also uses c.digest, whose read_bytes has no finite byte bound or descriptor-relative no-follow open. This misses the plan's operational-pin and bounded-read boundary for the mutating stage.
findings.requestedFix: Pin the reviewed helper and fixed Go/observer through bounded FD reads before assemble can execute, then recheck around each perform and each later stage. Use explicit small helper/observer caps and a finite real-Go cap, retaining the existing hash constants.
